channel.title: HeroHubs - Software development, architecture and AI
channel.description: Ranieri Vannozzi's blog on software development, architecture and artificial intelligence, in English and Italian.

item.title: Claude Design and Pomelli: the brand as context an AI can read
item.description: Claude Design derives a team design system from its code, Pomelli derives a small business Business DNA from its website. Two different products reach the same conclusion: consistency does not come from the prompt but from a profile extracted once and reused every time.

item.title: Performant npm: the package manager that rethinks node_modules
item.description: Performant npm is not just a faster npm. The global store with hard links and the strict node_modules structure change the way a JavaScript project declares and uses its dependencies.

item.title: Paperclip: building AI agent companies with an org chart
item.description: Paperclip lets you design an org chart of AI agents that collaborate like the departments of a real company. A CEO, a writer, an engineer, an editor and a designer who split the tasks, work in parallel and ask for confirmation when it matters.

item.title: DeepSeek locally: integrating an open model into SaaS without paying for APIs
item.description: Running DeepSeek on your own machine turns the variable cost of APIs into a fixed hardware cost. A reasoning on when it pays off, how it is done, and which other open models to evaluate for next-generation intelligent SaaS.

item.title: Claude Science: when the assistant walks into the lab
item.description: Anthropic launches Claude Science, an environment that links more than sixty scientific databases and coordinates specialised agents for genomics, proteomics, and computational chemistry. Not a more capable model, but a new way of working for researchers.

item.title: Sakana Fugu: when value lies in orchestration, not in the model
item.description: Sakana Fugu is not a new AI model but a small seven-billion-parameter orchestrator that coordinates existing models. The value shifts from computational power to the ability to orchestrate.

item.title: The .claude folder: the control centre of Claude Code
item.description: The .claude folder is often ignored, yet it is where the behaviour of Claude Code on a project is actually defined. Understanding its structure means moving from correcting the tool to configuring it.

item.title: Conventional Commits: the commit message as a technical document
item.description: Writing commit messages freely is a convention that forms through inertia. Conventional Commits replaces it with a structure that generates value automatically.

item.title: Brute force protection: authentication that holds
item.description: A brute force attack is not sophisticated, but it is persistent. Building a solid defence is an architectural question first, a configuration question second.

item.title: Why is ignoring package-lock architectural suicide?
item.description: Many developers treat the lock file as background noise in commits. In reality, it is the only thing standing between your code and a sudden crash in production.

item.title: Claude for Small Business: AI that works right beside you
item.description: Small businesses don't need massive tools to compete. They need intelligent ones. Anthropic's Claude is designed for those who work every day with limited resources but real ambitions.

item.title: Markdown or HTML? Output format is an architectural decision
item.description: Most developers treat AI output format as a minor detail. It isn't. The choice between Markdown and HTML determines whether the result will be read, shared, or actually used.

item.title: Canary vs Blue Green: how to eliminate downtime
item.description: A guide to software release strategies: discover how Blue Green and Canary deployment can protect your business and improve user experience.

item.title: Prompt Injection: how artificial intelligence can be manipulated (and why you should know about it)
item.description: Discover what prompt injection is, how it can influence artificial intelligence responses, and what strategies to adopt to protect data and business processes.

item.title: How to turn AI Assistants into reliable development partners
item.description: Discover how prompt engineering is becoming an essential skill for developers. Practical techniques for debugging, refactoring, and implementing new features with AI assistants.

item.title: Biome: the modern toolchain that simplifies web development

item.title: Test driven development: a silent ally for software heroes
